findings.title: Hard-coded fallback JWT signing secret
findings.description: When JWT_SECRET is unset the module silently uses the literal 'dev-secret-change-me', which is public in the repo; a production misconfiguration then accepts forged tokens. Fail fast at startup if JWT_SECRET is missing instead of falling back.
findings.suggestion: Throw at module load when process.env.JWT_SECRET is empty; remove the default.
